component.name: UriOnlyScene
component.script:
sub init() ' Mimics apps (e.g. Playlet) that never set the id field and walk a list of ' fallback uris, advancing on "failed" until one reports "ready". m.uris = ["pkg:/missing-library.zip", "pkg:/library.zip"] m.index = 0 loadLibrary() end sub
sub loadLibrary() if m.lib <> invalid m.lib.unobserveField("loadStatus") m.top.removeChild(m.lib) end if m.lib = m.top.createChild("ComponentLibrary") m.lib.observeField("loadStatus", "onLoadStatusChanged") m.lib.uri = m.uris[m.index] print "after set uri: " + m.lib.loadStatus end sub
sub onLoadStatusChanged() print "uri-only loadStatus changed: " + m.lib.loadStatus if m.lib.loadStatus = "ready" bar = createObject("roSGNode", "MyComponentLib:Bar") print "uri-only bar subtype: " + bar.subtype() else if m.lib.loadStatus = "failed" m.index++ loadLibrary() end if end sub
